project.name: kernel-smsserviceprovider-msg91
project.description: Reference SMSServiceProvider SPI using the MSG91 HTTP API. SMSServiceProviderImpl validates mosip.id.validation.identity.phone then GET-calls mosip.kernel.sms.api with authkey, sender, route, unicode, and country code (mosip.kernel.sms.enabled, country.code, number min/max length, api, sender, password, route, authkey, unicode). Auto-loaded via META-INF/spring.factories (EnableAutoConfiguration to SMSServiceProviderImpl and ApiExceptionHandler). kernel-core supplies logging; do not add kernel-logger-logback. kernel-auth-adapter injects MOSIP tokens on outbound calls. Versions from parent kernel-ref-parent; module description lives in this pom, not in README.md or AGENTS.md. Swap vendor by replacing the impl, not the SPI. bootstrap.properties is excluded from the packaged resources.
